Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis Report

Mean Ablation Method: This analysis applies mean ablation to identify critical attention heads for subject-verb number agreement. Mean ablation replaces a component's output with its average activation calculated across the entire dataset. This maintains normal activation levels while stripping away prompt-specific information. This method is more robust than zero ablation as it avoids triggering unpredictable failures.
